name: Sarah Ferguson
role: British author, charity patron and former Duchess of York (born 1959)
summary: Known as an author, charity founder and former member of the royal family, not as a political figure. Her only recorded political-adjacent remarks are support for the monarchy and sympathy for Ukrainian refugees after Russia's 2022 invasion.
